competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times to absorb its Attack Bar by 10% with a 25% chance each.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 4 times to deal damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken. The damage dealt increases by 50% if the enemy is granted with a beneficial effect.

effets.note: If the enemy is granted with a beneficial effect.

competences.description: Always gains attribute advantage when you are attacked by an enemy. Increases your Attack Speed by 15%, up to 150%, whenever you are attacked or attacking an enemy. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The skill always has an elemental advantage regardless of monster elements.
effets.note: When you are attacked by an enemy.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be increased by 30%.
effets.note: Up to 150%, whenever you are attacked or attacking an enemy
